text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day in late December, I see Admire
Vega
unusually engrossed in a newly
arrived racing
magazine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The main article is on the Umamusume
who will be
competing in the upcoming
year-end Grand Prix,
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: あ、そういえば――
choice_data_list_en: Oh, speaking of which—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: 出走者に選ばれてたな、ナリタトップロード
出走者に選ばれてたね、ナリタトップロード
choice_data_list_en: Narita Top Road was chosen as one of the runners.
Narita Top Road was chosen as one of the runners, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She's really popular...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega slowly traces her finger
along the
article.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for choosing me. I'll do my
very best
to live up to your
expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she examines Narita Top Road's
radiant photo,
her eyes narrow just
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her facial expressions now are less stern

compared to when we first met...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's fast approaching the three-year
milestone
since her debut race. And,
fortunately, the
holidays are almost
here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I go searching
everywhere for a
gift, but...
choice_data_list: （労いの気持ちもこめて、何か贈りたいな）
choice_data_list_en: (I'd like to give her a gift to show my appreciation.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to give her something she'll be
happy to
receive, but I need some kind
of clue for the right
approach.
choice_data_list: （うーん、決まらない……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Hmm, I just can't decide...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, my anxious pondering brings
my
attention to the perfect person to
help with this
task.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whoa there, if it isn't Ayabe's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who better to ask for gift advice than
Admire
Vega's roommate? I'm certain
she'll have an idea!
choice_data_list: カレンチャン！いいところに……！
choice_data_list_en: Curren Chan! Just in the nick of time...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... About thaaat...
choice_data_list: ちょっと相談したいことがあって……！
choice_data_list_en: There's something I'd like to ask your advice on...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Can't help you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm in a bit of a rush! So, like, sorryyy!
choice_data_list: えっ
choice_data_list_en: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame I have to return home
empty-handed,
but I accept it... The
following day...
choice_data_list: そ、そっか、こっちこそ急にごめんな
そ、そっか、こっちこそ急にごめんね
choice_data_list_en: I-I see. Sorry for springing this on you out of nowhere.
I-I see. Sorry for bringing this up so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Okay... so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see... also...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! In that case... after
which...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They might be able to give me some
useful
information. I muster up the
courage to approach
them.
choice_data_list: （ライバルのみんなだ……！）
choice_data_list_en: (It's all her rivals...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwaagh?! A-Ayabe's trainer?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haah ha ha! ...Retreat!
choice_data_list: 急にごめん！ちょっと聞きたいことが――
choice_data_list_en: Sorry out of the blue! There's just something I wanted to ask—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, umm... that would make me feel
bad, but...
Uhhh...
choice_data_list: え！
choice_data_list_en: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry! Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wait for meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I don't get the chance to ask
my
question.
choice_data_list: えええ……！？
choice_data_list_en: Whaaat...?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, everyone close to
Admire Vega
is blatantly ignoring me.
Was it something I did?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I need to reconsider the way I
act? As I
spend time mulling over the
issue...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The big day arrives before I know it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eventually settled on giving her a
comfy sports
towel, but I'm beginning to
worry it might be too
boring of a gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking I should follow up with a little
extra, I
decide to try putting up holiday
decorations
around the room, though I'm
not sure this would
get a positive
reaction from her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hello...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all my fruitless worrying,
Admire
Vega suddenly turns up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her hand is a small gift...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sorry, before that, I need to ask...
choice_data_list: ……って、え？あれ！？
choice_data_list_en: ...Wait, huh? What!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why are you trying to give me a gift?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Curren? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you later—let's hurry and get out
of here!
Your trainer showed up outta
nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! And it sounds like it's for
the same
reason we're here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: To buy a present!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're kidding... But why?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We can figure that out later! First of all,
we need
to leave!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You don't want your trainer figuring what you bought, do you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ayabe, Ayabe! Listen, we have to
go! Your
trainer is right over there!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And, and, and... I th-think I know why! I
think your
trainer's here to buy you a
present!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I know, but why though?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you give will just make me
want to
return the favor in kind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And... you've already done so much for
me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Helping me discover and understand
who I really
am.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Putting me through all this training...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Watching me in all my races...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Following me down the path I chose...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And pushing me forward whenever I lost
my way.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who has to repay you for
everything
you've done. And after
asking around, I finally
decided on
something.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But now you've thrown things off
balance by
getting me a gift too... I
don't know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the same uncompromising sense
of duty
that kept her bent on repaying
her perceived
debt to her late sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering all of this, I shake my
head slowly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list: 君が困ることなんてひとつもないよ
貴方が困ることなんてひとつもないよ
choice_data_list_en: There's not a single thing for you to worry about.
There's nothing for you to be troubled by

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That isn't true at all...
choice_data_list: 俺だってたくさんのものをもらってるから
私だってたくさんのものをもらってるから
choice_data_list_en: Because I've received so much from you, too.
Because I've received so much from you too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's—
choice_data_list: 元気に走る姿がたくさん見られた
choice_data_list_en: I got to see plenty of them running with great energy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What? That's not—
choice_data_list: 夢の手伝いをさせてもらえた
choice_data_list_en: I was able to help with her dream.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 君の担当でいさせてもらえた！
貴方の担当でいさせてもらえた！
choice_data_list_en: I get to stay on as your Trainer!
I get to stay on as your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After staying silent for a moment,
Admire Vega
lets out an incredibly long
sigh before beginning
to talk.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You know... I've been thinking this for a
while...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I really don't understand you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The package I receive from Admire Vega
contains
a simple navy blue fountain
pen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah...
choice_data_list: 夜みたいな色で、いいな
夜みたいな色で、いいね
choice_data_list_en: It's the color of the night sky. I like it.
It's the color of the night sky. Looks great.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I thought so too. That's why I bought it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I thought so too. That's why I bought it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The evening unexpectedly turns into a
gift
exchange, with Admire Vega finally
accepting my
present.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's a towel?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, that doesn't bother me...
choice_data_list: その、無難でごめんな
その、無難でごめんね
choice_data_list_en: Um, sorry for playing it safe.
Um, sorry for playing it safe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 一応手触りにはこだわったんだが……！
一応手触りにはこだわったんだけど……！
choice_data_list_en: I was quite particular about how it feels to the touch, though...!
I was quite particular about how it feels to the touch, though...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... you definitely threw things off
balance
with this gift.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...This is exactly the type of thing I like.
choice_data_list: えっ
choice_data_list_en: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I really like fluffy things.
